title: Roast squash and chickpea bulgur with feta

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything here is a whole food or a plain cupboard staple: squash, onions, chickpeas, bulgur, stock, feta, lemon and parsley.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray and foil, and the method is simple roasting and baking.

works.reason: The bulgur-to-stock ratio of 1:2 under tightly sealed foil, the 220°C roast and the quantities of squash, chickpeas, bulgur and feta all suit four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is fair for chunking an unpeeled squash, cutting onion wedges, making stock and chopping parsley, and the 20 plus 15 minutes in the steps matches the 35 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps under its true name, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Roast butternut squash is the centre of a warm tray bake that suits early September.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling family dinner of vegetables, pulses, wholegrain and cheese.
